'''Sayan Mondal''' is an Indian entrepreneur and software developer. He is the founder of '''Shotlin''', a digital product studio, and the founder and chief executive officer of '''Opslin''', a platform for deploying software to virtual private servers.<ref name="IND1">{{cite news |title=[INDEPENDENT SOURCE REQUIRED] |work=[OUTLET] |date=[DATE] |url=[URL]}}</ref>

=== Shotlin ===
Mondal founded '''Shotlin''', a digital product studio that designs and builds websites, mobile applications and business software for clients.<ref name="IND2">[INDEPENDENT SOURCE REQUIRED: coverage of Shotlin]</ref>

=== Opslin ===
Mondal is the founder and chief executive officer of '''Opslin''', a managed deployment platform that lets developers and teams deploy websites, APIs and backend software to Linux servers they own or rent, rather than to servers hosted by the platform.<ref name="IND3">[INDEPENDENT SOURCE REQUIRED: coverage of Opslin]</ref> The service connects to a customer's server through an outbound agent and provides domain and SSL setup, monitoring, logs and rollback to a previous release.<ref name="OPS">{{cite web |url=https://www.opslin.com/ |title=VPS Deployment Platform — Deploy to Your Own Server |website=Opslin |access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref> The company has described the product as being in beta, and has announced plans for a server-discovery tool and a software marketplace.<ref name="OPS" />
